title: One-Block Orbit K-Type Proposition
body_html:
One-Block Orbit K-Type Proposition

For a single positive-depth block and its lifted datum, the isotypic component of the generalized lattice-model orbit satisfies \[ S(B_0)_\Omega[\eta\otimes\eta']\simeq \eta\otimes\eta'. \]
proof_html: The orbit subspace is an induced representation from the stabilizer \(S\). Lemma 7.4 computes the \(K_{M,+}\)-isotypic component of the stabilizer representation and identifies its induction with the Heisenberg-Weil type \(\kappa_M\). Frobenius reciprocity reduces the multiplicity to the finite quotient statement \[ \operatorname{Hom}_{\Delta^0}(\rho\otimes\rho',1), \] which is one-dimensional because \(\rho'\) is transported contragredient to \(\rho\).
